target: acceptance 4 — a probe that CANNOT CONNECT takes the unverifiable path promptly. Note this exercises connection-refused, not a genuine hang; case 013 is what proves the --max-time bound is on the executed request.
cmd: printf "OPENROUTER_API_KEY=or-test\n" > .env; printf ".env\n" > .gitignore; OPENROUTER_CATALOG_URL='http://127.0.0.1:9/models' bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doctor.sh" > out 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; grep -i 'could not' out
_note: Honest scope: 127.0.0.1:9 fails via ECONNREFUSED in milliseconds, so this does not exercise the 5s timeout. Simulating a real accept-but-never-respond server needs a background listener, which is platform-dependent and flaky in CI. The bound itself is asserted by case 013 against the executed argv.
